Commentary.Commentary: 516 is the target set for the Lankans. It's highly unlike they're going to chase it down, so they're best and most realistic option is to play it out for a draw. Even that seems a bit out of reach given there are two full days after this one. They can't think that far ahead either, as their primary task is to survive the remainder of the day. Don't go anywhere, we'll be right back.

The Kangaroos bundled out Sri Lanka for a mere 215, got a healthy lead of 319 and then stepped up more from that point on. They actually lost early wicket, including that of one of the centurions in the first innings Joe Burns, but Khawaja and Head took things under control and never looked back. Their century stand has more or less sealed this game. Khawaja notched up a much-needed ton, while Head added another fifty to go with his first-innings hundred.

So the declaration finally comes. We all thought it'd come after Travis Head's fifty, but it's come after Usman Khawaja scored a ton, accelerating towards the end quite well. Tim Paine and the management feel there are enough runs on the board. Though, to be honest, they've had enough a good while ago.
Full on off, Travis drives it to mid off.
Bouncer again and this time Head ducks underneath it.
Slower delivery full on leg. Khawaja flicks it away towards square leg for a run.
Bouncer! Usman ducks underneath it.
On middle and leg, flicked to the on side by Head. He rotates the strike.

CENTURY FOR USMAN KHAWAJA! His 8th in Test cricket. Take a bow, lad. Full on leg, Khawaja flicks it to backward square leg and gets a single. He has battled hard for this one. Truly deserves it and he needed this one after having a patch run of form.
Vishwa Fernando back into the attack. Will this be the last over before declaration?
Flighted on off, Head defends it.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman
Shorter in length, Head cuts it straight to the fielder at cover.
Drifting down the leg side. Khawaja flicks it away fine of fine leg and takes three runs. Moves onto 99 with those three runs.
On the pads, Travis flicks it to mid-wicket and gets to the other end.

On the pads, flicked away to deep square leg for a single.

Full and straight on the stumps, worked to mid-wicket.
Full in line of the stumps, Usman reverse sweeps it to short third man.
Harmless delivery well outside off, Travis drives it square through the off side and picks up a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Full length ball outside the line of off stump, driven straight to mid off.
Landed on a good length, angling in from around off, punched back to the bowler off the back foot.
Short of a good length and it's pulled through backward square leg. A single is collected.
On a length and just around off, Usman mistimes the drive towards mid off as he plays it on the up.
FOUR! This Aussie pair is just scoring for fun now. Length ball outside off, Khawaja stands his ground and crashes it through the gap in the covers for another boundary.
Full and loopy on the stumps, Travis Head comes forward and dead-bats it.
Pushes it wide of the cover fielder and changes ends.
5th Test fifty for Travis Head! Nicely done. He deserves it for the way he's played. Gets to the milestone by punching it to mid off and taking a single.
Goes deep inside the works it to backward square leg for a run.
FOUR! Makes sweet connection on that. Floated on middle and off, Khawaja sweeps it in front of square leg and that will be a boundary.
Quicker and straighter on leg stump, it's reverse swept through point for two.

Drinks break. Australia firmly in control, cruising, in fact motoring along as Khawaja and Head pile on the runs. The declaration is imminent from the looks of it, seems they're just waiting on Head's fifty.
Ahead of a length outside off, angling in, Khawaja plays away from his body and gets an inside edge down to fine leg. One run to the total.

A little too straight in line, flicked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Flatter on off, pushed away to the fielder at mid off.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Loopy delivery on middle and leg, Travis sweeps it to the fielder at short fine leg.

Flighted on middle and leg, Travis blocks it.

Good length delivery on off, Usman defends it from the crease.
Down the leg side. Khawaja looks to flick but misses it.
Bouncer. Khawaja sways away from it.
On middle and leg, Khawaja pushes it to the fielder at mid on.
Length delivery on the stumps, Khawaja defends it.

Sliding in on middle and leg, it catches the batsman on the thigh pad as he looks to play at it.

Once again shorter length de3livery. Head gets under it and lets the keeper take it.
Bouncer. Travis ducks underneath it.

The slider again, on leg stump, keeps going down with the angle as Usman goes back to play. Is rapped on the pads, but to no avail.

Drifting in on middle and leg, worked in front of short leg.

Full outside off, Usman drives it to cover and gets off the strike.

Khawaja is well inside the crease though as his direct hi, hits the stumps and goes the other side. They steal another run. Two runs taken.
Kasun Rajitha comes back into the attack.
Flatter on off, Travis cuts it straight to the fielder at short third man.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flighted on middle, Head defends it.
Flighted on off, pushed away to cover for a run.
Shorter length delivery outside off,  Travis cuts it square to point for a single.

Dilruwan Perera back into the attack.
Bumper on middle and leg, the left-hander crouches low and lets it sail over his head.

Plays with soft hands. Length ball outside off, it takes the edge and falls short of the slip cordon.

The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! Shorter in length, Head gets onto his back foot and hits his pull through mid-wicket for another boundary. Runs coming thick and fast now.
Flighted on middle and leg, the ball spins away after pitching. Head cuts it to the fielder at point.

On the pads, Travis flicks it to mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Tossed up on middle, Head comes down the track and hits it through mid off. The ball does not go to the fence but Travis manages to get two runs.
Shorter in length, Head punches it to the fielder at cover.
Flighted on middle, Travis hits it to the fielder at silly mid on.
Tossed up on middle, Head charges down and taps it back to the bowler.
On a length on off, Usman defends it.
FOUR! Full outside off, Khawaja drives it wide of the fielder at short cover and the ball reaches the fence for a boundary. Moves onto 49 with that boundary.
Good length delivery on off, Head flicks it to square leg and gets to the other end.
Fuller length delivery on middle, Usman flicks it to square leg for a run.

Length delivery on the pads, Khawaja flicks it away to fine leg and rotates the strike.

Short and wide outside off, cut square through the off side for a run.

On the shorter side, outside off, punched wide of backward point for one.

Dhananjaya de Silva back on to bowl.
Stays right behind the line and defends this one out.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Full ball and it's driven to mid on for one.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, quicker in pace, Khawaja rocks onto the back foot and cracks it through point for a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The 50-run stand is up with this. Head flicks this through the mid-wicket region and gets to the other end. Solid stand between these two.
Fullish in length, keeps it around off, another defensive shot on offer.

Worked away on the leg side for no run.

Flatter on middle, Khawaja defends it.

Dilruwan Perera back into the attack.

No ball. Good shot and good fielding. Short outside off, Head cuts it square but the fielde rthere stops it. No run taken. Chamika over stepped his line and the umpire signals it as no ball.

We are back for the final session of the day. Usman Khawaja and Travis Head will resume their innings. Chamika Karunaratne will bowl the first over. A minimum of 39 overs left in the day. Here we go...
... Third Day, Evening Session ...

After bundling out Sri Lanka quickly after Lunch, Australia decided to bat again. The openers did not last long and both Harris and Burns departed. Labuschagne followed soon after. Khawaja struggled initially, but looks more settled now after getting his eye in and he is accompanied by Travis Head. With every passing over, the game is going further away from the visitors. The hosts are taking their time and  scoring as and when they get an opportunity. Their lead now is at 386 runs. Sri Lanka are staring down the barrel, but all they can do is chip away at the wickets and try to get them as soon as possible. Remains to be seen if Tim Paine decides to have a go with the ball today itself or not. Join us in a short while for all the action from the last session.
Sees the session off without any problem. Flighted outside off, turns away slightly, Travis Head strides forward and lets it go. Australia lead by 386 runs. TEA ON DAY 3!
Tossed up on middle and leg, turned behind square on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Bowls it short and pays the price for it. On middle and leg, Khawaja pulls it hard through square leg and sends it across the boundary line.

Loopy and full, on the fourth stump line, pushed towards the man at cover.

Full and fired outside off, driven straight to the man at cover.

Play and a miss! Fuller length ball outside off, Head plants his front foot forward and looks to smash this through the covers, but only connects with thin air. Chamika appeals for a caught behind but gets nothing from the umpire.
Moving away off the seam, a length ball outside off, Travis lets it be.

Fuller on the stumps, Head closes the face early and gets a safe leading edge towards covers.

This full delivery is driven to the cover region.
Shaping away from outside off, it's patted towards point with an open face.

Good length ball, a touch straight in line, worked through the vacant mid-wicket area for a run.
Chamika Karunaratne will come on to bowl.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Delivers a length ball in the corridor of uncertainty, Head covers the line and watches as the ball goes past him.

No ball! Oversteps again. Length delivery on off which is blocked.
Back of a length outside off, the batsman covers the line and lets it go.
From around the wicket this time, keeps low again, Head plays away from his body but it goes off the inside edge towards fine leg. Two runs collected.
Hurls it outside off on a good length, Travis attempts to cut but it keeps a little low and goes off the bottom edge to the keeper behind, on the bounce of course.
Drags it short and keeps it outside off, Head backs away and cracks the punch through covers for a single.
Quite full again, Travis wrists it towards mid on for nothing.
Full and attacking the stumps, kept out by coming well forward.
FOUR! Makes good use of the feet and after that, it's just a matter of picking out the gap. Travis Head does well really well. Skips down and drills it through the right of mid off. Another boundary.

Length ball around off, pushed tamely to the cover region.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Angling away from outside off, left alone for the keeper to collect.
FOUR! Shot. In complete control of that. Shortish on middle, Khawaja rises, gets on top of the bounce and pulls it through square leg to find the fence.

A bit of banter in the middle between Dickwella and Khawaja in the previous over. The Lankan keeper tells the Aussie that he wants him to score some runs here as he doesn't want him to watch him team on TV.
Length delivery, kept out with the full face of the bat.
Skips down the track to this tossed up ball and eases it to long on for one.

From around the wicket, it's flighted outside off, Khawaja lets it go past him.
Shaping away from around off, dabbed into the off side for no run.
Banged in short, ducked and evaded by the batsman.

Length delivery on off, Labuschagne moves a step across and blocks it down on the off side.
Kasun Rajitha returns to the attack.
Flatter delivery, Khawaja goes back to play but the ball keeps a bit low. The batter does well though to adjust and bring his bat down to defend.

Goes deep inside the crease, plays it with the spin through square leg and crosses over.

Finally does. After 16 deliveries. Labuschagne leans into this half-volley on the pads and flicks it through mid-wicket. It won't go all the way, but it's enough to fetch him three runs.
Ahead of a length, angling across around off, Labuschagne prods forward in defense. He is yet to get off the mark.

Bowls it fuller and keeps it well outside off, Marnus presses forward and pushes it on the off side.
Good length delivery on middle stump, Labuschagne leans across and works it down in front of mid-wicket.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flatter on middle, Usman pushes it to the fielder at mid on.

Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flighted on middle, Usman comes down the track and pushes it to the fielder at mid on.
Tossed up on middle, Khawaja comes down the track and lofts it over mid on. It is not timed well and Khawaja is not the quick between the wickets so he only gets a couple.
On middle and leg, shorter in length. Khawaja keeps it out.
Back of a length delivery on off, Marnus defends it.
Full outside off, Labuschagne knows where his off stump is and lets it go.
Good length delivery outside off, Labuschagne shoulders arms to it.
Back of a length on off and middle, Labuschagne blocks it off his back foot.
Full on off, Labuschagne pushes it to the fielder at cover.
Length delivery outside off, Marnus shoulders arms to it.

Drinks. It has been Australia's hour of play. After bundling out the Sri Lankan tail quickly after Lunch, they decided not to enforce the follow-on. They have lost both the openers but have a lead of 350. Kasun Ranjitha and Vishwa Fernando both have a wicket apiece but the bowlers will have to bowl out of their skins to wrap up Australia as quickly as possible.
Short and flat, around off, punched off the back foot but straight to mid off.
Stays right behind the line of this one and defends.
Some air provided on this one, on middle and off, driven to mid off from the front foot.
Rocks onto the back foot in a jiffy and punches it to mid off.
Straighter in line of the stumps, pushed back down the track.
Sliding in from around the wicket, shorter on middle and off, Khawaja goes back and wrists it in front of square leg.
Dilruwan Perera comes on to have a go with the ball.
Full on the fourth stump line, Labuschagne does not disturb that and leaves it.
Full on off, Marnus gets on his front foot and defends it with a straight bat.
On middle and leg, Khawaja flicks it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Outside off on a length, Usman chooses to leave that one.
Full on middle and leg, Usman flicks it to the fielder at mid on.
Bouncer. It is on the leg stump line. Khawaja ducks underneath it.

FOUR! Gets off the mark in style. Full inswinging ball to the left-hander. It is on the pads and Khawaja flicks it away through square leg for a boundary. This will boost his confidence.
Length delivery on off, Khawaja defends it off the back foot.
Outside off, Usman is not tempted by it and leaves it alone.
Length delivery outside off, Labuschagne shoulders arms to it to start his innings.
Manus Labuschagne replaces Joe Burns in the middle.

OUT! Brilliant catch from Kusal Mendis. Full around off, Burns goes after it looking to push but gets a thick outside edge. It looked like it was falling short of the fielder at first slip but Mendis dives to his left from second slip and takes a good low catch. A big wicket for Sri Lanka, the centurion from the last innings has departed. Two quick wickets down now for the Aussies.

Good length delivery on off, Joe pushes it to the fielder at point.

Length delivery on the fourth stump line, Burns knows where his off stump is and leaves it.
Fuller outside off, Burns leaves it alone.
Good length delivery on middle, Joe defends it.
Length delivery outside off, Usman leaves it alone.

On the fourth stump line. Burns lets the keeper feel it.
